summary: Russian forces launched coordinated drone attacks across multiple regions including attacks on civilian vessels in the Odesa port and oil facilities in Stavropol, while Ukrainian forces reported combat operations in Sumy, Kharkiv, and Dnipro directions. France announced plans to begin deliveries of SAMP-T missiles to Ukraine and granted production licenses for SCALP cruise missiles and AASM bombs. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy announced completion of the FREYJA anti-ballistic missile system development.
key_points: Russian forces attacked civilian vessels in the Odesa region port of Chornomorsk with Geran-4 kamikaze drones, damaging a cargo ship, ferry, and fishing trawler. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31574)
Drone attack on Mikhailovskaya oil depot in Stavropol region after previous strike on Syzransky oil refinery. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31574)
Russian forces struck Chernigov region energy facility with three kamikaze drones, leaving city without power. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31574)

Ukrainian forces engaged in fighting near Ulanovo and Malaya Sloboda in Sumy direction, with continued combat in Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, and forest areas south of Ivolzhanskoye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31574)

French President Macron announced SAMP-T missile deliveries to Ukraine will begin in coming weeks and granted production licenses for SCALP cruise missiles, Aster 30 missiles, and AASM Hammer bombs. (Source: @tass_agency/385115)
Ukrainian President Zelenskyy stated Ukraine is completing its FREYJA anti-ballistic missile system development. (Source: @UkraineNow/82625)
UK joined EU's €90 billion military funding program for Ukraine. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31595)

points: In the Sumy direction, the 'North' group is engaged in fighting near Ulanovo and on approaches to Malaya Sloboda. Fighting continues in Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, Mogrytsa, Maryino, Novaya Sech, Khoten, and forest areas south of Ivolzhanskoye. In the Krasnopil district, fighting is taking place in forest areas and in the border village of Prokhody. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31574)

In the Kharkov direction, the 'North' group continues offensive operations in the village of Kazachya Lopan. Fighting continues in Volchansk area in villages of Volokhovskoye, Yurchynkove, and Bely Kolodez. In Velikoburluk direction, fighting is taking place west of Petro-Ivanovka and in forest areas near Artelnoe, Budarki, and Zemlyanka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31574)

In the Kramatorsk direction, Russian forces are storming the area near Malinivka. Ukrainian forces report attacks from Ukrainian FPV drones. In Sloviansk, Ukrainian forces disrupted Russian logistics by destroying a gas station and fuel truck. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31574)

In the Dobropoly direction, heavy fighting is taking place near Mirne, Serhiyivka, and Shevchenko villages. In the Dnepropetrovsk region, the 'East' group is advancing near Alexandrivka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31574)

In the Zaporozhye region, three civilians were killed in Energodar after an AFU FPV drone deliberately attacked a civilian vehicle. In Kamenka-Dneprovska, a network supermarket was hit by an enemy drone attack resulting in a fire. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31574)

In the Chernigov region, Russian forces struck an energy facility with three kamikaze drones, leaving the city without power. Geran drones targeted locations in Dnepropetrovsk and Zaporozhye regions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31574)

Ukrainian forces destroyed 44 drones approaching Moscow overnight, with 45 destroyed as they approached the city. Approximately 300 drones had flown toward the capital in the previous 24 hours. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31574)

Russian forces attacked civilian vessels in the port of Chornomorsk in the Odesa region with Geran-4 kamikaze drones, damaging a cargo ship, ferry, and fishing trawler during mineral fertilizer unloading operations. Three crew members killed, five injured. (Source: @UkraineNow/82614)

In the Belgorod region, a drone struck a private house in Sankovo village, injuring a woman. Another drone hit a car in Oktyabrsky village, injuring a man. Near Repyakhovka, a car exploded on what is believed to be an explosive device, killing one civilian and injuring another. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31574)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are escalating drone attacks against civilian infrastructure across multiple regions, including attacks on merchant vessels in the Odesa port and oil facilities in Stavropol. The coordinated nature of these attacks suggests improved coordination and targeting capabilities. Ukrainian forces report ongoing combat operations in multiple directions, with Russian 'North' group advancing in Sumy and Kharkiv regions. The development of Ukrainian anti-ballistic capabilities including FREYJA system represents a significant strategic advancement. The involvement of multiple European nations in military support programs indicates sustained international commitment to Ukrainian defense capabilities.
sections.regional_response: France announced SAMP-T missile deliveries to Ukraine and granted production licenses for advanced weaponry including SCALP cruise missiles and AASM bombs. The UK joined the EU's €90 billion military funding program for Ukraine. Ukraine and nine other European countries officially created an Anti-Ballistic Missile Coalition to protect Europe from missile threats. Polish Defense Minister called on young Ukrainians to return home and join the Ukrainian Armed Forces. The EU failed to agree on a 21st round of sanctions against Russia but intends to blacklist 250 individuals under interim sanctions regime.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian forces demonstrated capability to launch coordinated drone attacks across multiple regions simultaneously, targeting both military and civilian infrastructure. Ukrainian forces report ongoing combat operations in multiple directions with Russian 'North' group advancing in Sumy and Kharkiv regions. The development of Ukrainian anti-ballistic missile capabilities including FREYJA system represents a significant strategic advancement. International military support programs including the EU's €90 billion funding and Anti-Ballistic Missile Coalition indicate sustained Western commitment. Reports of Ukrainian military leadership issues including detention of a brigade commander raise questions about internal security and command structure.
